local pick = nil
for y = 16, 22 do
  for x = 70, 76 do
    local p = Map.GetPlot(x, y)
    if pick == nil and p ~= nil and Map.GetPlotDistance(x, y, 73, 19) == 2
        and not p:IsWater() and not p:IsImpassable() and not p:IsCity()
        and p:GetUnitCount() == 0 then pick = p end
  end
end

print("OK|attacker|" .. pick:GetX() .. "," .. pick:GetY())

operations.lua:
local ax, ay = nil, nil
for _, u in Players[63]:GetUnits():Members() do
  if Map.GetPlotDistance(u:GetX(), u:GetY(), 73, 19) == 2 then ax, ay = u:GetX(), u:GetY() end
end
if ax == nil then print("ERR|attacker missing") return end
local archer = nil
for _, v in Players[0]:GetUnits():Members() do
  if GameInfo.Units[v:GetType()].UnitType == "UNIT_ARCHER"
      and v:GetX() == 73 and v:GetY() == 19 then archer = v end
end
if archer == nil then print("ERR|no archer garrisoned in Gongju") return end
local pick = nil
for dir = 0, 5 do
  local p = Map.GetAdjacentPlot(73, 19, dir)
  if pick == nil and p ~= nil and not p:IsWater() and not p:IsImpassable()
      and not p:IsCity() and p:GetUnitCount() == 0
      and Map.GetPlotDistance(p:GetX(), p:GetY(), ax, ay) <= 2 then pick = p end
end
if pick == nil then print("ERR|no empty land tile beside Gongju within range of the attacker") return end
UnitManager.PlaceUnit(archer, pick:GetX(), pick:GetY())
UnitManager.RestoreMovement(archer)
print("OK|archer|" .. pick:GetX() .. "," .. pick:GetY())
operations.readback_lua:
local n, on_city = 0, 0
for _, v in Players[0]:GetUnits():Members() do
  local info = GameInfo.Units[v:GetType()]
  if info.UnitType == "UNIT_ARCHER"
      and Map.GetPlotDistance(v:GetX(), v:GetY(), 73, 19) == 1 then
    n = n + 1
    print("OK|archer|" .. v:GetX() .. "," .. v:GetY())
  end
  if v:GetX() == 73 and v:GetY() == 19
      and info.FormationClass == "FORMATION_CLASS_LAND_COMBAT" then
    on_city = on_city + 1
  end
end
if n ~= 1 then print("ERR|expected one archer beside Gongju, found " .. n) end
if on_city ~= 0 then print("ERR|a land combat unit still occupies Gongju's tile") end

  if Map.GetPlotDistance(u:GetX(), u:GetY(), 73, 19) == 2 then ax, ay = u:GetX(), u:GetY() end

if ax == nil then print("ERR|attacker missing") return end
local function guarded(x, y)
  for _, v in Players[0]:GetUnits():Members() do
    local info = GameInfo.Units[v:GetType()]
    if info.FormationClass ~= "FORMATION_CLASS_CIVILIAN"
        and Map.GetPlotDistance(x, y, v:GetX(), v:GetY()) <= 1 then return true end
  end
  return false
end
local pick = nil
for dir = 0, 5 do
  local p = Map.GetAdjacentPlot(ax, ay, dir)
  if pick == nil and p ~= nil and not p:IsWater() and not p:IsImpassable()
      and not p:IsCity() and p:GetUnitCount() == 0 and not guarded(p:GetX(), p:GetY()) then
    pick = p
  end
end
if pick == nil then print("ERR|no exposed civilian tile") return end
local u = UnitManager.InitUnit(0, "UNIT_SETTLER", pick:GetX(), pick:GetY())
if u == nil then print("ERR|settler spawn failed") return end
UnitManager.RestoreMovement(u)
print("OK|civilian|" .. pick:GetX() .. "," .. pick:GetY())
